newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algerian president to visit China.
newsitem.headline: Algerian president to visit China.

text.p: Algeria's President Liamine Zeroual is to pay a five-day visit to China, starting on October 17, in a broad tour taking him to Arab and Asian countries, the official Algerian news agency APS said on Thursday.

The agency said Zeroual's tour was at the invitation of Arab and Asian leaders, including Chinese President Jiang Zemin. APS named only China among the countries to be visited by the Algerian president.
Algeria has a continuous strong relation with China, which helped the North African country with a heavy water nuclear research reactor in Ain Oussera town, 150 km (90 miles) south of Algiers.
The two countries early last June signed a draft agreement for nuclear cooperation for peaceful purposes.
China was also involved in irrigation, agricultural works and construction projects, including a three-star hotel near Algiers airport.
